message: No detected input validation: The code loads JSON directly with json.load() and passes it to downstream functions without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from a local file path only; there is no remote fetch, and no checksum or integrity verification of any kind is performed.

No detected label flipping detection: There is no validation of label values against an expected set, no label distribution comparison, and no label-noise detection tool used anywhere in the data preparation flow.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The code loads features directly from pickle files and assembles them into a matrix without any outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs.

No detected model integrity verification: The code trains models from scratch (KNN, Random Forest) and loads only feature data from pickle files; no pretrained weights or serialized models are loaded, and no hash/signature verification is performed on any loaded artifacts.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, verifies expected label sets, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used in any part of the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of adversarial attack frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) or any robustness stress testing anywhere in the evaluation code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While KFold cross-validation splits data into train/test folds, there is no held-out test set isolated before training begins, no signing or hashing of evaluation data, and no independent verification mechanism to protect against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The code loads JSON data and constructs feature matrices directly from pickled files without any shape, range, or schema validation before passing data to the model.

No detected output bounds checks: Prediction outputs from knn_predict and rf_predict are used directly in evaluation functions with no NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or sanity validation on the returned predictions.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses classical ML classifiers (KNN, Random Forest) rather than an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
